items.question: How are the straight fingers arranged in the śaṅkha mudrā?
premises: Fingers are united in layered union.
items.inference: Layered union of straight fingers constitutes the mudrā.
uncertainties: Exact finger mapping is not specified.
items.plain_english: In the śaṅkha mudrā, the straight fingers are united in layered union.
